tickets.thesis: Highest-conviction tradeable name from the debate (6.0). Clean 20d breakout on volume_above_threshold with the tightest proportional risk in the set (~3.5% to the 989.78 stop) and no small-float retail-pump signature, so the setup's asymmetry survives the bear's beta-rally caveat. Entry/stop/targets are taken directly from the live scanner line (entry 1026.10, stop 989.78, T1 1074.52, T2 1098.73), not from any headline. Size is capped at 10 shares (~INR 10,261) by available cash (INR 10,557) rather than the fuller ATR risk budget, deploying the remaining dry powder into the single best fresh long while CDSL, DLF, HDFCBANK and SBIN hold. No news catalyst, so no evidence is cited.
